codes.setup_code_too_short: This copy’s setup code has fewer than 12 letters A–Z or digits, so it can’t be used. Set a longer one (other characters, such as accents or other alphabets, don’t count) and try again.
codes.recovery_not_ready: Your copy doesn’t have a new setup code yet. If you just changed it, wait a moment (sometimes a few minutes) and try again.
codes.already_claimed: This copy is already set up. Sign in with your access key.
codes.not_claimed: This copy isn’t set up yet.
codes.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
codes.rate_limitedFor_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} minute.
codes.rate_limitedFor_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} minutes.
codes.network: There’s no connection to the server.
codes.file_too_large: The file is larger than the maximum allowed size.
codes.upload_incomplete: The upload was interrupted. Try again.
codes.last_workspace: You need to keep at least one workspace.
codes.restore_place_in_trash: Restore what this belongs to first: it’s in the trash too.
codes.restore_place_gone: The place it belonged to no longer exists, and there’s nowhere else to put it.
codes.vault_key_changed: The vault changed in another tab or on another device. Open it again.
codes.too_many_columns: A board holds up to 20 columns.
codes.vault_full: The vault holds up to 5,000 items. Delete the ones you no longer use to add more.

server: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.
